name: Context meter
oneLiner: a thick glass gauge fills green to orange to red while the value counts up toward its max, glyph groups (files, tools) drop in above it as it fills; split mode shows a thin first segment, then a big second segment floods in and fills with labelled blocks
say: when the speaker says something fills up or eats a budget ('it loads every file and you've burned 140k tokens before you ask'), or, in split mode, says a small part versus the big rest ('the prompt is 10%, the other 90% is the harness'): the count lands on the number they say. 9:16 also takes layout top
